3. Mathematical Methodology

Adds an \(\ell_1\) penalty on standardized slopes (leaving \(\beta_0\) unpenalized) to perform continuous shrinkage and automatic variable selection via coordinate-wise soft-thresholding.

$$\min_{\beta_0 \in \mathbb{R},\, \boldsymbol{\beta} \in \mathbb{R}^p} \frac{1}{2n}\|\mathbf{y} - \beta_0\mathbf{1} - \tilde{\mathbf{X}}\boldsymbol{\beta}\|_2^2 + \alpha\|\boldsymbol{\beta}\|_1, \qquad \hat{\beta}_j = \mathcal{S}\!\left(\frac{1}{n}\tilde{\mathbf{x}}_j^\top \mathbf{r}^{(-j)}, \alpha\right) \quad \left(\lambda \equiv \alpha \ge 0,\ \frac{1}{n}\|\tilde{\mathbf{x}}_j\|_2^2 = 1\right)$$

Implementation Note: min_{beta0, beta} (1 / (2*n)) * ||y - beta0 - X*beta||_2^2 + alpha * ||beta||_1 (intercept beta0 unpenalized)
CV-Selected Hyperparameter: \(\alpha^* = 0.00247248\) (\(\lambda \equiv \alpha\)) over 60 grid points in \([0.002472, 24.72]\).

7. Limitations and Conclusions

Facts & Interpretations

  • [Computed Fact] Held-out test performance (\(n_{\mathrm{test}} = 4253\)): \(R^2 = 0.7371\), \(\mathrm{RMSE} = 17.4\) K (Train \(R^2 = 0.7363\), Train \(\mathrm{RMSE} = 17.63\) K).
  • [Computed Fact] Largest standardized coefficients by magnitude: wtd_gmean_atomic_radius (-65.02), wtd_mean_atomic_radius (+63.39), std_ElectronAffinity (+27.86).
  • [Computed Fact] KFold(5, shuffle=True, seed=42) selected \(\alpha^* = 0.002472\) (CV RMSE = 17.71 K, CV \(R^2 = 0.7339\)), converging in 27186 coordinate-descent iterations.
  • [Interpretation] Soft-thresholding retained \(|A(\alpha^*)| = 75\) of \(p = 81\) predictors and eliminated 6 (7.4% sparse), reducing the \(\ell_1\) norm from 1123 (OLS) to 812.2 (ratio = 0.7231).
  • [Computed Fact] Eliminated predictors include mean_fie, wtd_gmean_fie, mean_atomic_radius, mean_Valence, wtd_mean_Valence (max \(|r|\) with a retained predictor = 0.995).

Assumptions & Limitations

  • [Selection Instability Under Collinearity] 12 predictor(s) varied in selection across CV folds (e.g., wtd_std_atomic_mass (0.80), gmean_fie (0.80), wtd_std_atomic_radius (0.80), wtd_range_Density (0.80)), because \(\ell_1\) KKT pinning selects one representative among correlated features.
  • [Linearity Assumption] Linear models assume additive linear relationships between standardized predictors and conditional target expectation.
